test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Study the given diagram carefully and answer the question. The numbers in different sections indicate the number of persons. The circle represents 'sports persons', the square represents 'coaches', and the triangle represents 'administrators'. How many sports persons are there who are also coaches but NOT administrators?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eca130ec8fc9fca15718436908a781b47285475589edf43da5d19cab0ac394b6.png]
solution:
Circle = Sports persons

Square = Coaches

Triangle = Administrators

Total no. of sports persons who are coaches and administrators are 4 

But the highlighted portion shows sports persons who are coaches but NOT administrators are 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f266553ac5e76b63bc54400b4b185a8fb4f53128b25eb31da28256ab954a42c.png] 

Hence, **"Option 4"** is the** correct answer.**
